nodes.name: Database Constraints
nodes.summary: Comprehensive reference for all database constraints: 56 primary keys (SERIAL), 26 unique constraints (24 single-column + 2 composite), 124 foreign keys grouped by ON DELETE behavior (CASCADE/RESTRICT/SET NULL/NO ACTION), NOT NULL and nullability conventions, default values for status workflows and financial fields, and application-enforced integrity rules for state machines and workflow transitions.

nodes.name: Entity-Relationship Diagram
nodes.summary: Mermaid ER diagram covering 56 tables across 10 domains (Auth, CRM, Catalog, Equipment, Quotation, Rental, Movement, Maintenance, Inventory, Billing) with 708 total columns and 124 FKs. Illustrates inter-domain data flows, FK cascade types (CASCADE/RESTRICT/SET NULL), and confirms all FK chains are acyclic with no circular references.

nodes.name: Database Index Strategy
nodes.summary: Documents ~161 total indexes: 56 implicit primary key indexes, 26 unique constraint indexes, ~70 explicit single-column indexes on FK/status/timestamp columns, and 9 proposed composite performance indexes targeting invoice aging, cash flow, fleet utilization, per-asset TCO, maintenance cost aggregation, active contract filtering, and revenue recognition reporting.

nodes.name: Migration Order
nodes.summary: Documents the 5-migration Alembic chain (initial 55-table schema → forklift_specs table → data migration for mast_type → 9 performance indexes → kpi_targets table), the 8-level dependency-sorted table creation order for all 56 tables, development (SQLite create_all) vs production (PostgreSQL Alembic) strategies, additive-only safety rules, and step-by-step apply/rollback instructions.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL Schema Documentation
nodes.summary: Master schema reference: 57 tables (56 current + kpi_targets) across 11 domains with estimated row counts, naming conventions (snake_case plurals, LAK currency default), FK ON DELETE patterns, unique constraint summary, default value patterns, the 9 new performance indexes from migration 001, and deployment instructions for fresh setup and incremental migration via Alembic.

nodes.name: Table Definitions
nodes.summary: Column-level reference for all 56 tables across 10 domains: type, nullability, default value, and constraint annotations for every column. Provides full inline DDL-style definitions for Auth, CRM, Catalog, Equipment, and Quotation domains (5 domains, 28 tables); summarizes key column sets for Rental, Movement, Maintenance, Inventory, and Billing domains referencing postgresql-schema.sql for full DDL.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL DDL Schema
nodes.summary: Full DDL reference for the DK CRM PostgreSQL database: 56 CREATE TABLE statements across 10 domains plus all CREATE INDEX statements (~95 indexes). Covers Auth (3), CRM (4), Catalog (8), Equipment (9), Quotation (4), Rental (8), Movement (2), Maintenance (6), Inventory (6), and Billing (6) domains. Reference document only — Alembic manages actual deployment.

nodes.name: roles
nodes.summary: RBAC role definitions (super_admin, manager, sales, support). Lookup table with unique name, description, and is_active flag. Referenced by users.role_id with SET NULL on delete.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Staff user accounts with RBAC role assignment. Stores hashed_password, unique email and username, superuser flag, and last_login. Used as created_by/updated_by/assigned_to across every domain via SET NULL foreign keys.

nodes.name: customers
nodes.summary: Customer records with 4-stage lifecycle (prospect → active → inactive → churned). Unique email, optional company, assigned_to user. RESTRICT FK on rental_contracts, invoices, and deposits prevents customer deletion while active records exist.

nodes.name: leads
nodes.summary: Sales pipeline leads with 7-stage status (new → contacted → qualified → proposal → won → lost). Links to an optional customer, tracks estimated value and lead source (website/referral/cold_call/email/social_media/other).

nodes.name: brands
nodes.summary: Equipment and parts manufacturer brands with unique name and slug, brand_role (primary/parts_only/both), logo_url, country, and website. Referenced by products, forklifts, forklift_models, and spare_parts with SET NULL on delete.

nodes.name: products
nodes.summary: Spare parts and accessories product catalog. Unique SKU and slug, multi-language names (Lao + English), brand and category FKs (SET NULL), and boolean classification flags (is_sale, is_rental, is_service_item). Supports EAV-style specs via product_specs child table.

nodes.name: forklifts
nodes.summary: Core equipment asset entity. Tracks unique serial_number and internal_code, model/brand references, current status (in_stock/rented/in_service/reserved/decommissioned), condition, fuel type, capacity_kg, and hour meters (initial + current). Central hub: RESTRICT FKs from Rental, Maintenance, and Movement domains prevent deletion of active equipment.

nodes.name: forklift_models
nodes.summary: Equipment model catalog linking brand to series, fuel_type, capacity_kg, and max_lift_height_mm. Unique slug for URL routing. Referenced by forklifts.model_id with SET NULL on delete.

nodes.name: quotations
nodes.summary: Sales quotations with 10-stage workflow (draft → under_review → approved → revision → sent → accepted → rejected → expired → converted → cancelled). Supports revisions via parent_id self-reference (SET NULL), polymorphic converted_to_id (no FK), full financial calculation fields (subtotal/tax/discount/total), and links to customer, lead, and assigned user.

nodes.name: rental_contracts
nodes.summary: Core rental entity with 13-stage lifecycle (reservation → draft → pending → approved → active → closed). 38 columns covering contract financials, billing configuration (cycle_day, payment_terms_days), penalty rates (overtime/late/early-termination percentages), delivery address/contact, and full audit trail. customer_id FK is RESTRICT. Hub for billing, movement, and maintenance operations.

nodes.name: rental_billing_cycles
nodes.summary: Periodic billing records generated per rental contract item. Tracks 10 billing_types, period start/end dates, quantity, unit_rate, amount, tax, and payment_status (pending/invoiced/paid). Performance index on payment_status enables efficient overdue cycle detection.

nodes.name: invoices
nodes.summary: Invoice lifecycle management (draft → issued → sent → partially_paid → paid → overdue → cancelled → voided). Tracks 7 financial fields (subtotal through balance_due), billing period, sent/cancelled timestamps. RESTRICT FKs on contract_id and customer_id. Performance composite index on (status, customer_id) for customer statements.

nodes.name: payments
nodes.summary: Payment records for customers linked to optional rental contracts. Tracks 6 payment methods, 4 statuses (pending/confirmed/rejected/cancelled), amount, payment_date, reference_number, and confirmation audit. Linked to invoices via payment_allocations many-to-many table.

nodes.name: deposits
nodes.summary: Security, advance, and guarantee deposits for rental contracts. 6-stage lifecycle (pending → received → refunded/forfeited/applied/cancelled). Tracks deposit_type, amount, refund_amount, forfeit_amount, applied_amount, and payment references. RESTRICT FKs on contract_id and customer_id.

nodes.name: work_orders
nodes.summary: Maintenance work orders with 6-stage lifecycle (scheduled → in_progress → completed → verified → cancelled → on_hold). Links to forklift (RESTRICT FK), maintenance_schedule, and maintenance_plan. Tracks priority, estimated/actual hours and costs, findings, and resolution. Parent of maintenance_costs and service_history child tables.

nodes.name: spare_parts
nodes.summary: Spare parts catalog with unique part_number, 11 part categories, optional brand reference (SET NULL), unit pricing in LAK, and stock control parameters (min_stock_level, reorder_quantity, lead_time_days). Stock levels per warehouse tracked in inventory_balances. RESTRICT FK prevents deletion with transaction history.

nodes.name: warehouses
nodes.summary: Storage location definitions with unique warehouse code (e.g., WH-01), name, address, and contact info. RESTRICT FK on inventory_balances, inventory_transactions, and purchase_orders prevents deletion of warehouses with stock or transaction history.

nodes.name: asset_movements
nodes.summary: Delivery, retrieval, and transfer logistics for forklifts. Tracks movement_type, from/to locations with addresses, scheduled and actual departure/arrival timestamps, driver assignment, and optional GPS tracking_code (unique). forklift_id is RESTRICT FK. Checkpoint log stored in movement_history child table.

nodes.name: revenue_recognitions
nodes.summary: Accrual accounting entries for rental contract revenue (5 recognition types, 3 statuses: scheduled/recognized/reversed). Links to invoice, invoice_item, and rental_contract. Tracks recognition_date, period start/end, and amount. Performance index on recognition_date for period reporting.
